title: Bound on a defaulted list entry
statement: Let $l$ be a list of integers and $U$ an integer with $0\le U$. If every entry $x$ of $l$ satisfies $|x|\le U$, then for every natural number $i$, the value at position $i$ with default value zero also satisfies $|l_i^{(0)}|\le U$.
hypotheses_covered: Every entry of $l$ has absolute value at most $U$
